description: This file defines the class TranslationCollection, which encapsulates collections of translation mappings used in internationalization (i18n) within the OrangeHRM system. It manages key-source/target, key-target, and source-target translation pairs.

classes.name: TranslationCollection
classes.description: A class that manages collections of translation key-value pairs for internationalization in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getKeyAndSourceTarget
methods.description: Returns the array of translation entries mapping keys to source and target labels.

methods.name: getKeyAndTarget
methods.description: Returns the array of translation entries mapping keys to target labels.

methods.name: getSourceAndTarget
methods.description: Returns the array of translation entries mapping source texts to target texts.
